run_aggregation_forward: run the Aggregation forward pass to compute weighted aggregation over point features using CUDA
run_aggregation_backward: run the Aggregation backward pass to compute gradients for input, position, and weight tensors
test_Aggregation_forward: test the Aggregation forward method with contiguous input, position, weight, and idx tensors
